rows.en: What we want is peace where we can live free!!
Kotaro Minami, I hereby sentence you to execution!

Kotaro Minami… I'll destroy every last bit of the transformation function inside your body!

From now on, you'll be space dust, wandering the graveyard of the cosmos for all eternity… Hahhahahaha…
Gaah!? Gwaaaaaaah!!

Ah… ugh… Huh, something's off? This isn't BLACK's body!?

Was I… was I reborn?
That's impossible!? I destroyed every bit of Kotaro's transformation function!

This is a Kamen Rider we have never seen before!

No doubt Kotaro transformed into a new Kamen Rider through some terrifying power beyond our understanding…

Maribaron! Send the Chap Soldiers to attack him!!
…!? What's that?
A new Kamen Rider? Who in the world could that be? An enemy? An ally?
Doesn't look like an enemy… does it?
A new Kamen Rider? Who in the world is that? An enemy? An ally?
Doesn't look like an enemy, huh?
Nobuhiko… have you lost your memory?

So Nobuhiko really is dead… and the Shadow Moon I once knew is dead too!

What stands here now is… nothing more to me than a powerful enemy!! Here I come! Shadow Moon!!

Battle Hopper!!

Were you reborn too?
Battle Hopper!? Then that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
Battle Hopper!? Then that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
Battle Hopper!? Then that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
Battle Hopper!? Then that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
No way!? Battle Hopper? So that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
No way!? Battle Hopper? So that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
Huh!? Battle Hopper? So that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
Huh!? Battle Hopper? So that means… that Kamen Rider is Kotaro?
I am the child of the sun… Kotaro Minami has been reborn! Kamen Rider BLACK RX!!

You'd even lay a hand on a helpless child for your own ends!?

Have you sunk that low? Shadow Moon!! I won't forgive you!!

You'd even lay a hand on a helpless child for your own ends!?

Have you sunk that low? Shadow Moon!! I won't forgive you!!
Nngh… Maribaron! Unleash the Kaima Robot Cubrican on the surface!! Snuff out his life!!
Yes, sir! Cubrican… descend to the surface and destroy them!!
Well done, BLACK… Ugh… I lose!
Shadow Moon!! You promised. Give Masaru back!
Kuh… Relax! I've hidden Masaru somewhere safe.

Ugh… Leave the child… to me! I still have enough strength left to get him home safely…

More importantly… beware the Crisis Empire.
The Crisis Empire?

Invaders from another dimension…

They'll be coming for Earth from the Crisis Empire, ruled by the Crisis Emperor… Their supreme commander, General Jark, may be even stronger than I… Ugh…
Nobuhiko…!

They are making their preparations as we speak… Soon they'll appear before you as well.

Fight, BLACK! And… don't lose, Kotaro Minami!
Nobuhiko…
Kuh… Ugh…
Nobuhikooo!!

My name is Shadow Moon…

Someday I will rise again, Kamen Rider BLACK… and challenge you once more! I'll let no one else have your head!!

Shadow Moon…

Nobuhiko, don't you die! I'm counting on you to look after Masaru… Nobuhiko… Nobuhikooo!!

Oh… Kotaro, are you all right? Are you hurt?

I just got word from Jiro. He says Masaru made it back safe! Thank goodness…

Masaru did? Really? I'm so glad!

"Thank you, Nobuhiko…"

Oyassan… I'm kind of starving. Could you make me the usual?
Coming right up! One special curry, extra large!!
Gwoooooooh…

Kotaro…

You have been… revived as Kamen Rider BLACK RX by the life energy of the sun's rays!
The life energy of the sun's rays?

That is right…

The light of the sun shines on all things in this world. It is the love of the universe, giving life to every living being!

Kotaro, from this day on you are the child of the sun. As Kamen Rider BLACK RX, you must fight those who are evil… and protect the Earth!

That is your destiny!
If that's my destiny, then I'll give it everything I have and fulfill it!

Kotaro…

The light of the sun has given Kamen Rider RX a fearsome power… and given you superhuman strength as well.

Take heed, Kotaro… If you use that power in front of others, people will praise you at first, but in time they will come to shun you…

The joy of living as a human, which you desire from the bottom of your heart, will be lost, and you will have to live all alone…
But… I can't fight this alone! And I don't want to end up all alone!
Kotaro… shun the path of the foolish, and walk the path of the wise!!

Wait a second, please!

Telling me something that complicated just leaves me stumped… Who are you? Please show yourself!!
I am the King Stone… your soul.
The King Stone… my soul…
His transformation function destroyed and cast out into Kaima Space, Kotaro Minami had resigned himself to death.
But the King Stone embedded in his body absorbed the sun's energy and revived Kotaro as Kamen Rider BLACK RX.
It was truly a majestic miracle of the cosmos… And so, the first shots in the battle against the Crisis Empire were fired.
Kamen Rider BLACK RX! I shall remember you… Heh heh heh… Hah hah hah hah hah!!

What's this? You ran off and that was it… At least get in touch!!

Unlike Takeshi or Hayato, you're way too reckless. I can't help worrying…

Aha… Sorry. I'll be more careful from now on!

More importantly, Oyassan… I'm kind of starving. Could you make me the usual?
Coming right up! Special curry, extra large… right?
Damn it, I can't… lose in a place like this… I can't… lose… nngh…
Defeat Shadow Moon and rescue Masaru!
Defeat all Mysterious Soldiers!
Defeat all Chap Soldiers!
Defeat the Kaima Robot Cubrican and all Chap Soldiers!
Meanwhile… at MAT headquarters, Earth's remaining forces were secretly gathering!

In accordance with the decision of the recent Earth Defense Conference regarding the Space Fortress Naager, our TDF will launch a preemptive strike!

As of 12:00 today, TDF Far East Base issues DEFCON 1! We are on a war footing!

We must stop that space fortress from entering the atmosphere at all costs!!

And in the unlikely event…

that we fail to stop the Space Fortress Naager's advance, we will begin a long-range missile strike!

This will be… the largest missile strike ever, carried out by every TDF branch at once…
I want the Science Patrol and MAT to each assemble a select team for combat in outer space, and get them ready to sortie!
Yes, sir…
Hey… Go's running late, isn't he?
Shhh!

Hey! Where's Go!?

The Space Arrow leaves in 30 minutes, you know?
Sir… He'll be here any moment…
This won't do! You're his seniors, and you haven't trained him properly!
Yes, sir! We're terribly sorry!

H-Hideki Go…!

As a member of the MAT select team, to stop the advance of the Space Fortress Naager, as of now I am…

uncertain: U12836-U12843: same line given to HERO2/HERO4 and to Lucifard, Fadita, Velvet, Vortex speaker tags (route/pilot variants); translated identically, only the interjection differs (うそ = 'No way', え = 'Huh').
U12852: narration row continues Shadow Moon's line from U12851 (split row); written as continuation without speaker.
U12854: read 可いは as 或いは ('may be even stronger than I').
U12889: TDF is not in the glossary; kept as acronym.
U12890: read 最大総 as 最大級 ('the largest missile strike ever').
U12900: Go cuts himself off mid-report; left unfinished.
omissions_kept: U12830/U12832: 'Doesn't look like an enemy' keeps the dropped 'he/it' style subject; the newcomer's identity is unknown to the speaker.

new_names.why: not in glossary (Terrestrial Defense Force); kept acronym
